correctness.rationale: Direct source-to-sink EFX equivalence uses simple-graph single-edge property. On a cycle its exact forbidden triples yield even independent change sets and a two-to-one map to orientations. A two-state cyclic transfer matrix gives the Lucas and sixth-period term; direct exhaustive valuation inequalities for n=3..14 agree and the argument proves all n>=3. The k-count and limiting probability follow without numerical assumptions.
